title: My Mobile AI Coding Setup: Tailscale, Herdr & Moshi
description:
Here’s a deeper look at the terminal setup I use to run AI coding agents from my Mac and seamlessly continue working from my phone.

I walk through how I combine Ghostty, Herdr, Moshi, Hermes, and Tailscale to create persistent terminal workspaces that remain accessible wherever I am. I also demonstrate switching between sessions, running agents like Hermes and Codex, using on-device speech-to-text, and securely connecting everything through a private Tailscale network.

Chapters

00:00 My terminal setup  
00:14 Organizing workspaces with Herdr  
00:42 Useful keyboard shortcuts  
01:20 Running AI agents  
01:45 Connecting from my phone  
03:01 How Tailscale connects everything  
03:59 Why I prefer this over traditional SSH  
05:03 Current limitations  
05:27 Moshi and on-device speech-to-text  

If you want to run persistent AI coding sessions from your computer and control them while you’re away, this setup is worth checking out.

Take your idea to revenue: https://sessions.alif.build

Having trouble with agents, join my (free) agentmaxxing community: https://www.skool.com/agentmaxxing/about
